_comment: FundingCAPTCHA runtime config. Edit screen_rect to match your physical install.

screen_rect._comment: World-space region (cm) that maps to the full game grid. X=right (horizontal on screen), Z=up (height on screen). Calibrate z0/z1 on-site to match screen bottom and top.

camera._comment: Used when running with --camera. Leave serial blank for first detected device.
